props.name: text
props.description: Text to read. It is rendered by the component, so the current word can be marked in it.

props.name: targetRef
props.description: Or read the text inside this element, in place. Highlighting needs the CSS Custom Highlight API.

props.name: lang
props.description: Language used to pick a default voice, e.g. `en-GB`. Defaults to the page language.
